extracted.name: Basic White Rice
extracted.description: Learn how to make white rice with flavor in a quick and easy recipe. This white rice yields a basic but tasty dish that goes with a range of meals.
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add rice, garlic powder, and salt. Pour in boiling water to cover rice by about 1 inch; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until water is absorbed and rice is tender, 20 to 30 minutes.
